text: ZenMux DSH 插件（Web）：通过浏览器 OAuth 登录，在 DeepSeek Harness 使用 ZenMux 模型。插件为 DSH 注册 /zenmux 命令，接入 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 模型，并按模型选择对应接口。用户可搜索模型、刷新目录、查看登录状态；访问令牌会自动刷新，推理请求附带当前会话标识。适合希望在 DSH Web 中使用 ZenMux 模型的用户；需要 ZenMux 账户授权，可选配置网络代理。

ZenMux DSH plugin: use models through browser OAuth in DSH Web. It registers /zenmux, routes Anthropic and OpenAI models, and supports model search, catalog refresh, and login status. Tokens refresh automatically; inference requests include the current session ID. A ZenMux account is required.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「OAuth 登录」：通过 /zenmux login 启动浏览器授权，并在本机回调后保存令牌；访问令牌可自动刷新。
@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「按协议路由」：将 ZenMux Anthropic 模型交给 Anthropic Messages，将 OpenAI 专属模型交给 Chat Completions。
@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「模型目录刷新」：运行 /zenmux models refresh，从 ZenMux 获取两类模型清单并写入 DSH 设置。
@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「模型搜索」：Web 模型选择器可按模型名称、ID 或提供方名称过滤目录，并保留匹配结果供选择。
@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「会话标识传递」：ZenMux 推理流期间把当前 DSH 会话 ID 加入请求头 x-zenmux-session-id。
@zenmux/dsh-plugins 的功能「登录状态与退出」：/zenmux status 查看连接状态，/zenmux logout 移除本地 OAuth 凭据。
使用前需通过 ZenMux 账户完成浏览器 OAuth 授权；插件将访问令牌用于模型请求，完整令牌集通过 DSH credentials 服务保存。
登录、令牌维护和模型目录刷新会连接 ZenMux 服务；可选配置 HTTP(S) 或 SOCKS 代理，推理请求使用配置的 ZenMux API 地址。

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · ZenMux for DeepSeek Harness：[中文说明](https://github.com/ZenMux/dsh-plugins/blob/main/README.zh.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/ZenMux/dsh-plugins) · [ZenMux](https://zenmux.ai)

Use ZenMux models in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) without copying an API key. Sign in through your browser, search the full model catalog, and let the plugin choose the cache-capable protocol for each model.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Features：- Browser OAuth login with automatic token refresh.
- 150 searchable text models in the current bundled catalog.
- 126 models routed through Anthropic Messages with prompt-cache controls.
- 24 OpenAI-only models routed through Chat Completions.
- Every ZenMux inference request carries the current DSH session in `x-zenmux-session-id`.
- `/zenmux login`, `/zenmux status`, `/zenmux logout`, and `/zenmux models refresh` commands.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @zenmux/dsh-plugins --latest
dsh web
```

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Sign in：In a DSH conversation, run:

```text
/zenmux login
```

Approve the ZenMux authorization page and return to DSH. Check the connection with `/zenmux status`; disconnect this installation with `/zenmux logout`.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Choose a model：Open the model selector and search by model name or ID.

- **ZenMux · Anthropic**: cache-capable models using Anthropic Messages. Claude Fable 5 belongs here.
- **ZenMux · OpenAI**: the remaining OpenAI-only models.

The first eligible Anthropic request can create a prompt cache. Later requests with the same prefix can report cache reads.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Update：Quit the running DSH process, update the plugin, then restart DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zenmux/dsh-plugins@latest
dsh web
```

Confirm the installed version with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web list --depth 0
```

Refresh the ZenMux model catalog (the command updates the settings file; restart DSH afterward):

```text
/zenmux models refresh
```

The command fetches both ZenMux OpenAI and Anthropic listings and preserves OAuth credentials and other provider settings.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · The latest plugin still shows only a few models：An older manual model list is overriding the bundled catalog. In `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`, remove only the `models:` arrays under `llm-pi-ai.providers.zenmux` and `llm-pi-ai.providers.zenmux-models`, then restart DSH. Keep credential references and unrelated providers.

text: @zenmux/dsh-plugins README · `API key is invalid` or `AUTH`：Run `/zenmux login` again.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Network or TLS errors：OAuth requests connect directly by default and can use an explicit HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy. Custom TLS interception may also require `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` before DSH starts. See the [implementation and rollout notes](https://github.com/ZenMux/dsh-plugins/tree/main/docs/sdd) for advanced deployment details.

@zenmux/dsh-plugins README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
```

Model catalogs are release snapshots generated from ZenMux's OpenAI and Anthropic model-list endpoints. Source and issue tracking live at [ZenMux/dsh-plugins](https://github.com/ZenMux/dsh-plugins).
